1.w: Remember, O YHWH, what has happened to us! Look and see our disgrace!

2.w: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, and our houses to foreigners.

3.w: Fatherless we have become, and those with no father; our mothers [are now] like widows.

4.w: Our water for silver we drink, [and] our wood comes in with a price.

5.w: Upon our necks we are pursued; we grow weary, and no rest [is] unto us.

6.w: [To] Egypt we have given our hand, [to] Assyria to be satisfied with bread.

7.w: Our fathers sinned, and [are] no more, and we bear their iniquities.

8.w: Servants rule over us; [there is] no one tearing us away from their hand.

9.w: With our soul we bring in our bread before the face of the sword in the wilderness.

10.w: Our skin like an oven grows hot from the face of the burning heat of famine.

11.w: The women in Zion they have pressed down, [and] the maidens in the cities of Judah.

12.w: Princes were hanged by their hands; [and] the faces of the elders were not honored.

13.w: Young men they have taken to grind, and boys stumble under the wood.

14.w: The old men have ceased from the gate; the young men from their music.

15.w: The joy of our heart has ceased, our dancing has turned to mourning;

16.w: the crown has fallen [from] our head—woe to us, for we have sinned!

17.w: Upon thus our heart has become faint; for these our eyes grow dim.

18.w: For Mount Zion, which is desolate; foxes have walked upon it.

19.w: You, O YHWH, remain forever—Your throne from generation to generation.

20.w: Why do You forget us forever? You forsake us for a length of days.

21.w: Return us, O YHWH, to You, and we will return! Renew our days as of old,

22.w: unless You have utterly rejected us, [and] remain angry with us even to exceedingly!
